highlights: Omnidirectional mobile robot automatically picks up and drops off carts
Manufacturer-specific T3 datasheet rates cart capacity at 750 lb (340 kg)
Automatic docking and configurable building-system integration support indoor deliveries
The exact T3 sheet rates cart capacity at 340 kg and maximum cart dimensions at 44 x 32 in. Compatible existing carts use an adapted base; the shared 1000 lb headline is not the T3 rating.

The exact sheet gives nine effective battery hours; the common T3/T3XL page advertises twelve hours without matching operating conditions. Both remain visible as a source conflict; automatic docking is not uninterrupted battery endurance.

The sheet separates body width and floor-measured height from the 33.81 in / 85.86 cm lift-surface length. Its turning envelope is 49.43 in / 125.56 cm; that is not silently treated as a radius or complete body footprint.

The four-wheel omnidirectional drive supports lateral/diagonal motion, automatic cart exchange and configurable door/elevator integration. Navigation without AGV guide infrastructure does not remove building integration, Wi-Fi, mapping or operational planning.

The sheet specifies a 12.7 mm threshold, 31.75 mm gap and 1:12 slope, with automatic charging and 3.2-hour charge time. These are manufacturer limits rather than guaranteed loaded performance on every site.

highlights: Four separately secured compartments support up to four delivery destinations per run. Optional employee PIN-plus-fingerprint access and arrangements with up to sixteen baskets are clinical workflow features, not a universal cybersecurity certification.
The exact model sheet gives 45 kg material capacity, ten-hour battery runtime and 3.2-hour charging. Payload mass is not unloaded robot weight; cabinet volume is not material mass or a water tank.

The center-drive chassis has lidar, side-curtain lidar, 3D sensors and sonar. Maximum 0.76 m/s travel, 12.7 mm thresholds, 31.75 mm gaps and 1:12 slopes remain deployment limits rather than independently tested all-site capability.

Standard compartments are 13 x 17 x 14 in W/D/H, or 27 x 17 x 14 in with the divider removed. The 34.7 in / 88 cm figure is a turning envelope in the table but labelled turning radius in the diagram; its geometric interpretation remains unresolved.

The charging dock is a separate accessory with its own dimensions, electrical ratings and compatibility list. Hardware/software elevator integration and remote Command Center support are services/configuration; T4H/T4E compatibility codes do not independently establish new robot models.
